'''Mohammad Hossein Rafiee Fanood''' ({{langx|fa| محمد حسین رفیعی فنود}}) (born 9 April 1945) is an Iranian scholar, pro-democracy activist,  and an author. He is a retired professor of [[polymer chemistry]] at [[University of Tehran]], and a member of [[Council of Nationalist-Religious Activists of Iran|Meli-Mazhabi (National-Religious)]] Alliance and Iran's National Peace Council. The Iranian regime arrested him in 2015 for his political views.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Rafiee |first=Anna Maryam |date=August 3, 2015 |title='I wonder if we are in a prison or a torture chamber': summer is hell in Iran's Evin jail |url=http://www.theguardian.com/world/iran-blog/2015/aug/03/iran-evin-prison-like-torture-chamber |website=[[The Guardian]]}}</ref>

== Life ==
Due to his political views and political-economical-social analysis he was arrested together with the other members of Meli-Mazhabi Alliance in 2000.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.hrw.org/news/2002/01/07/iran-trial-political-activists-begins|title=Iran: Trial of Political Activists Begins|date=7 January 2002|work=Human Rights Watch|access-date=14 April 2017}}</ref> Subsequently, in 2003, he was sentenced to four years of imprisonment and banned from any "social activity" for two years.

Threaten and pressure on Hossein Rafiee has been increased by Iran's intelligence and security apparatus, in 2014, after he wrote a comprehensive 120-page analysis of Iran's nuclear situation, titled "The Geneva agreement",<ref>{{Cite web| title=Geneva agreement; interests and national security, the fulfillment of Mr. Rouhani's election promises | url=https://www.mhrafieefanood.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/توافق-ژنو.pdf | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150701001312/http://www.mhrafieefanood.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/%D8%AA%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%81%D9%82-%DA%98%D9%86%D9%88.pdf | archive-date=2015-07-01}}</ref> in support of "Geneva interim agreement on Iranian nuclear program" between [[Iran]] and [[P5+1]] countries.

He has written several letters to President Rouhani and explained the pressures he has been facing due to his public support of the Geneva nuclear agreement. In one of his letters he mentioned:

"''...as I am 70 years old and the period of worldliness, power and post seeking is over for me, I intend neither to immigrate nor to give up on confronting those who think the only solution for Iran's problems are; prison, immigration, death, threats, restriction, isolation and suppression of intellectuals and political-social activists. Thus, I am ready for death...''"<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mhrafieefanood.com/%D9%86%D8%A7%D9%85%D9%87-%D9%BE%D9%86%D8%AC%D9%85-%D9%81%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%B1%D8%AF%DB%8C%D9%861394-%D8%A8%D9%87-%D8%AF%DA%A9%D8%AA%D8%B1-%D8%B1%D9%88%D8%AD%D8%A7%D9%86%DB%8C/|title=نامه پنجم فروردین1394 به دکتر روحانی - دکتر محمد حسین رفیعی فنود|website=www.mhrafieefanood.com}}</ref>

In May 2015, he was sentenced to six years in prison and received a two-year ban on political and journalistic activities.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.theguardian.com/world/iran-blog/2015/jun/29/iran-president-rouhani-support-mohammad-hossein-rafiee|title=President Rouhani must show the same courage he expects in other Iranians|first=Anna Maryam|last=Rafiee|date=29 June 2015|publisher=|accessdate=14 April 2017|newspaper=The Guardian}}</ref> His sentences linked to his activities and support of Nuclear deal.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.rsc.org/chemistryworld/2015/09/jailing-retired-iranian-chemist-linked-nuclear-deal|title=Jailing of retired Iranian chemist linked to nuclear deal|work=rsc.org|accessdate=14 April 2017}}</ref>

On 16 June 2015, he was arrested without a court order issued by judge in the street by Iranian security forces. He had been in hunger strike refused to take his medication in protest to the arrest for four days.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://en.iranwire.com/features/6585/|title=My father was accused of 'legal subversion!'|work=iranwire.com|accessdate=14 April 2017|archive-date=7 March 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160307044613/http://en.iranwire.com/features/6585/|url-status=dead}}</ref> Since then he has been kept in ward 8 of Evin prison under harsh condition.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://www.theguardian.com/world/iran-blog/2015/aug/03/iran-evin-prison-like-torture-chamber|title='I wonder if we are in a prison or a torture chamber': summer is hell in Iran's Evin jail|first=Anna Maryam|last=Rafiee|date=3 August 2015|publisher=|accessdate=14 April 2017|newspaper=The Guardian}}</ref> According to Amnesty International Hossein Rafiee is considered as prisoner of conscience.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.amnesty.org/en/documents/mde13/3652/2016/en/|title=Document|work=amnesty.org|accessdate=14 April 2017}}</ref>

== International supports ==
Many international organisations sent letters to Iranian authorities in support of Hossein Rafiee, demanding his release such as: "Scholars at Risks",<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.scholarsatrisk.org/2016/03/sar-calls-for-letters-on-behalf-of-imprisoned-iranian-scholar-of-chemistry-prof-mohammad-hossein-rafiee/|title=SAR calls for letters on behalf of imprisoned Iranian scholar of chemistry, Prof. Mohammad Hossein Rafiee|website=Scholars at Risk|date=10 March 2016 }}</ref> [[Committee of Concerned Scientists]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://concernedscientists.org/2015/07/ccs-protests-arbitrary-arrest-of-retired-tehran-university-professor/|title=CCS Protests Arbitrary Arrest of Retired Tehran University Professor|date=July 20, 2015|website=Committee of Concerned Scientists}}</ref> [[American Chemical Society]]<ref>{{Cite web | url=https://www.acs.org/content/dam/acsorg/global/international/acs_letter_mohammad_rafiee_july_2015.pdf | title=Letter to the Supreme Leader of the Islamic Republic of Iran about Dr. Mohammad Hossein Rafiee Fanood | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150923211200/http://www.acs.org/content/dam/acsorg/global/international/acs_letter_mohammad_rafiee_july_2015.pdf | archive-date=2015-09-23 }}</ref> and [[National Academy of Sciences]].
In February 2016 more than 300 Scholars and scientists in a letter to president of Iran demanded his release.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.science.org/content/article/researchers-call-iran-release-jailed-chemist|title=Researchers call on Iran to release jailed chemist|date=2 February 2016|work=sciencemag.org|accessdate=14 April 2017}}</ref> Again in April 2016, about 60 North American professors wrote a letter to President Rouhani and demanded his release.<ref>{{cite news |date=27 April 2016 |title=North American professors' plea to President Rouhani: the full letter |url=https://www.theguardian.com/world/iran-blog/2016/apr/27/iran-president-rouhani-open-letter-prisoners-urgent-need-medical-care-tehranbureau |accessdate=14 April 2017 |newspaper=[[The Guardian]] |publisher=}}</ref>
